notes: The official report of the Nebraska Board of State Canvassers (the canvass book), linked as 'General Election Official Results' from the Secretary of State's Previous Elections page: every contest the Board canvasses (federal, statewide and legislative offices, the State Board of Education, the Regents, judges' retention, community colleges, the Learning Community, natural resources, public power, utilities, reclamation districts, educational service units and the statewide questions), county by county, with each contest's Total row. The report's 'Reported Problems' page: Dodge County Shortly after early voting ballots were sent out, it was discovered that a candidate for Lower Platte North Natural Resources District Subdistrict 07, Doug Shuster, was left off the ballot. At that time, 2,761 ballots had been mailed or voted in office. The Dodge County Clerk posted an apology and explanation on their website, and impacted voters were notified and provided an opportunity to vote the contest. The Secretary of State notified candidates and the NRD. Ballots issued after this point, including for election day, were corrected ballots and not impacted. For the ballots already voted in office, a supplemental ballot was provided with only the Lower Platte North NRD Subdistrict 07 contest and a postage paid return envelope. For the ballots already mailed out, a corrected ballot was sent. The voters who already returned a ballot were provided a postage paid return envelope. The remainder were instructed to spoil the original ballot. If the corrected ballots were returned, they were counted and the corresponding original ballots were rejected. All original ballots submitted for counting and not corrected were duplicated by the Dodge County Resolution Board without the Lower Platte North NRD Subdistrict 07 contest. No votes were counted for Lower Platte North NRD Subdistrict 07 from original ballots. The difference in votes between Engel and Shuster was 2,014. All but 208 original ballots submitted for counting were corrected. As a result, the original early voting ballots that were submitted and not corrected did not impact the outcome of the election. Platte County Shortly after early ballots were sent out, it was discovered that Loup River P ublic Power District Subdivision 03 was not included on several ballot styles following redistricting. Of the 166 supplemental ballots sent out to impacted early voters who already received a ballot, 88 were returned and counted and 78 were not returned. All future early voters and election day voters received both the original ballot and supplemental ballot at the same time and thus had no impact. The margin in this contest was 393. As a result, this error did not impact the outcome of the election.
